about: Experiment 32 (docs/experiments.md). VGGT single mode, room A, the walk frame's camera token after global block g; experiment 27's 128 target-donor pairs. Transfer is the fraction of the target-donor line the prediction moves (mean); translation transfer is the same in the camera-from-world translation. Intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap over pairs (10,000 resamples, seed 0), paired across conditions.
